audited_terminal_families.basis: Campaign289 fits no marginal response map or correlation graph and keeps one joint fixed oblique partition.
Campaign289's eight oblique hyperplanes and thresholds are frozen without returns; no split, depth, leaf or boosting decision sees the target. Only cell means are supervised.
Campaign289 learns no representation, gradient parameter, architecture or hidden weight. The binary state and partition are fixed before returns.

Campaign289 does not reuse the ordinal percentile coordinates, cosine basis, smooth RBF similarity, projection dimension, seed, bandwidth, ridge penalty or output coefficients. It uses coarse median signs and one discontinuous cell mean.
The training target remains the exact continuous within-session forward-return percentile; no class or posterior probability is created.

fixed_mechanism_identity.fitted_parameter: one continuous target mean per occupied fixed cell plus one global fallback mean

conclusion: Campaign289 is admitted as one exploratory new estimator over an already exposed Alpha158 library. Admission does not rehabilitate or alter any prior terminal result and does not make historical results prospective evidence.
